source_state: Tested working tree based on base_commit plus tests/manual_ui_test.cpp changes; these new tests are not claimed to exist in base_commit. Root verified no product QML diff. Relevant source/test bytes are pinned below, not a full dependency closure.
scope: Offscreen synthetic keyboard and direct Qt accessibility-action tests with a recording endpoint. No real audio session, model or physical input hardware.

full_manual_ui.count_scope: Qt result rows include setup/cleanup; this is one CTest entry, not 229 CTest entries.

focused_keyboard_accessibility.scope: 13 behavior/data results plus init/cleanup; overlaps the full suite and includes unchanged arrow/wheel held-scratch cases. Do not sum these as unique results.

corrected_modal_oracle_original_QML.scope: One modal keyboard behavior plus init/cleanup, with original Main.qml.

behavior: At 1180x760 with 15px and 19px application fonts, Tab/Backtab reaches enabled controls in normal, active-tempo and deck-A-replacing states without audio endpoint commands. Reachability is bounded to 128 advances per phase/direction and does not prescribe complete control order.

Ctrl+O opens Library; BPM and Audio open through the keyboard. Escape restores each invoking control. Audio native Popup.activeFocus may be its container; actual Tab reaches content, Backtab remains in the popup and the next Tab reaches content again.
F6 toggles the theme twice. Modal checks permit exactly the existing one refreshRouting call and require unchanged complete fake endpoint deck maps.
Both jog controls expose native Dial accessibility with forward/reverse actions and existing 480-frame search increments. Replacement, unloaded and unavailable-output gates reject actions.
Both decks end a held scratch once before accessible positional search, matching the existing arrow/wheel path. Retired pointer input cannot move or end it again; a fresh press has a fresh token.

oracle_correction.rejected_assertion: Initial Audio focus had to be a descendant of contentItem. That overconstrained the native Popup focus container.
oracle_correction.resolution: The public Popup focus and actual key-traversal oracle passes original product QML. The temporary focus:true line was removed; no product defect or product fix is claimed. Original failure logs remain retained.

warnings.scope: Six existing CUE cancellation binding-loop messages and two older layout mouse-bound messages remain recorded. They were not suppressed or fixed by this test-only slice; focused and corrected modal logs contain no QWARN rows.

limits: Direct accessibility-action calls do not establish actual screen-reader or other assistive-technology operation.
No physical touchscreen, compositor focus/portal acceptance or musical mixing trial was performed.
No current engine/UI contention, callback performance, physical audio continuity or sustained live-stem latency was measured.
This local Qt 6.12 run does not establish supported Qt 6.4 runtime acceptance; CI is separate.
M2, M3 and release acceptance remain open. No qualification is claimed.
